lines.zh: 蠕动着前进，甲壳刮擦地面。
lines.en: Creeping, armor scraping the ground.

lines.zh: 缓慢爬行，骨茧微微振动。
lines.en: Moving slowly, the cocoon vibrates slightly.
Feet sweep the ground gently.

lines.zh: 身体扭曲，寻找前进路线。
lines.en: Body twists, seeking a path forward.
Moving slowly through the tunnel.
Feelers gently touch the walls.

lines.zh: 我在茧里慢慢挪动身子。
lines.en: Inside my cocoon I shift, slowly.

lines.zh: 缓慢爬行，避开锋利的尖刺。
lines.en: Creeping, avoiding sharp spikes.
Moving slowly through the dark.
Moving slowly, staying alert.
Lying quietly in the cocoon.
Sleeping in the darkness.
Creeping slowly in the cocoon.
Quietly waiting in the cocoon.

lines.zh: 静静地躺在坚硬的骨茧中。
lines.en: Lying quietly in the hard bone cocoon.
Twisting slowly in the cocoon.
Sleeping quietly in the cocoon.

lines.zh: 静静地躺在坚硬的外壳中。
lines.en: Lying quietly in the hard shell.
Sleeping quietly in the cocoon.

lines.zh: 静静地躺在坚硬的外骨骼中。
lines.en: Lying quietly in the hard exoskeleton.
A dull heartbeat leaks from the cocoon.
Faint light seeps through the bone seams.
An ancient breath, very slow.
The cocoon wall swells and settles.
Joint by joint, the body stiffens.
Even asleep, I gnaw on bones.
Noticing you, preparing to wake up.
The cocoon's unbroken. Don't knock.
Noticing the nearby player.
Noticing the threat to you.
A faint sound comes from inside the cocoon.
Noticing your approach.
Noticing your silhouette.
Noticing you, preparing to counter.
Noticing you, starting to wake up.
Your shadow falls on the cocoon wall.
Something living entered this layer.
You stepped on the edge of my cocoon.
An unfamiliar heartbeat woke me.
Light is leaking through the crack.
Who walks above my head?
The bones rot. Can you endure?
This feels sickening!
Corruption seeps into me!

lines.zh: 痛苦无法阻挡我的复仇！
lines.en: Pain cannot stop my vengeance!
My armor is everywhere!
You cannot harm me!
I am a servant of death!
Corruption will devour you!
You woke the death!
Despair surrounds you!

lines.zh: 茧口一裂，你就吵醒了我。
lines.en: The cocoon split — you woke me.
Taste my acidic saliva!
Your carrion won't satisfy me!
The Queen will awaken soon!
My tentacles can crush you!
Your voice woke me up!
You're just an appetizer for me!
Carrion! Carrion!
I am the sleeping king!
Let carrion feed me!
Move or suffer!
My scales can protect against anything!

lines.zh: 你碰到了我，现在付出代价！
lines.en: You touched me, now pay the price!
You've touched forbidden ground!
My shell protects me!

lines.zh: 你踩上来了，别再碰我的茧。
lines.en: You stepped on it—do not touch my cocoon.
My exoskeleton is extremely tough!
Touch me, and you die with nowhere to go!
I resist everything with toughness!

lines.zh: 我的茧壳不为你的刀让路。
lines.en: My cocoon shell does not yield to your blade.

lines.zh: 找到合适的配偶，开始繁衍！
lines.en: Find a mate to start reproducing!

lines.zh: 我的卵需要安全的环境！
lines.en: My eggs need a safe environment!
Find my eggs and protect them!

lines.zh: 只有真正的强者才能成为伴侣！
lines.en: Only the strongest can be my partner!
Protect my eggs, we'll coexist!
My eggs are deep underground!

lines.zh: 我的卵可以增强你的力量！
lines.en: My eggs can enhance your strength!
My eggs are rare treasures!

lines.zh: 我的卵能延续我们的生命！
lines.en: My eggs will continue our life!
Protect my eggs, let's reproduce together!

lines.zh: 茧壳破裂，虫体蠕动而出。
lines.en: The cocoon cracks, and the creature wriggles out.

lines.zh: 这远古的旋律唤醒沉睡中的生物。
lines.en: The ancient melody awakens the sleeping creature.

lines.zh: 它的身体由骨质构成，坚硬无比。
lines.en: Its body is made of bone, unyieldingly hard.

lines.zh: 尖锐的触角感知着周围的动静。
lines.en: Sharp antennae sense the surroundings.

lines.zh: 咀嚼着地下的腐骨，慢慢成长。
lines.en: Chewing on underground decayed bones to grow.

lines.zh: 夜幕降临，它才开始活动。
lines.en: It moves only at nightfall.

lines.zh: 它的血液如同古老符文般闪耀。
lines.en: Its blood glows like ancient runes.

lines.zh: 一旦醒来，便会展开骨翼。
lines.en: Once awake, it will spread its bone wings.

lines.zh: 在幽暗的地底深处寻找养分。
lines.en: It forages for nutrients in the dark depths.

lines.zh: 骨质外壳下藏匿着锋利的骨爪。
lines.en: Sharp bone claws hide beneath the exoskeleton.

lines.zh: 感知到威胁，它缓缓苏醒。
lines.en: It slowly awakens, sensing the threat.

lines.zh: 它的目光透过黑暗，锁定目标。
lines.en: Its gaze locks onto the target in the dark.

lines.zh: 骨质外壳发出沙沙声响。
lines.en: Its exoskeleton makes a rustling sound.

lines.zh: 骨翼展开，准备迎接战斗。
lines.en: Bone wings spread, ready for battle.

lines.zh: 发出低沉的骨鸣声，警告入侵者。
lines.en: It emits a low bone hum, warning the intruder.

lines.zh: 骨爪紧握，预示着攻击的到来。
lines.en: Bone claws clench, signaling the attack.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛闪烁着智慧的光芒。
lines.en: Its eyes gleam with wisdom.

lines.zh: 它那古老的身躯慢慢蠕动。
lines.en: Its ancient form slowly moves.

lines.zh: 骨甲在黑暗中发出磷光。
lines.en: Its bone armor glows in the darkness.

lines.zh: 它体内的力量正在集结。
lines.en: Its power is gathering within.
This body has memorized you.
The cocoon splits, the queen comes.
Waking me costs a great deal.
Your body heat seeps into my shell.
The worms in my seams start biting.
The seal loosened. Do you hear it?
I smell living bone.
A thousand-year anger has woken.
Target locked, it prepares to attack.

lines.zh: 它那骨质的长牙已经露出。
lines.en: Its bone fangs are already bared.

lines.zh: 骨爪紧紧抓住地面，增强力量。
lines.en: Bone claws grip the ground, strengthening its power.

lines.zh: 骨翼振动，准备释放骨粉。
lines.en: Bone wings vibrate, preparing to release bone dust.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛射出寒光，锁定猎物。
lines.en: Its eyes shoot cold light, locking on the prey.

lines.zh: 骨质的身躯准备发起冲锋。
lines.en: Its bone form prepares to charge.

lines.zh: 它那古老的智慧开始发挥作用。
lines.en: Its ancient wisdom begins to take effect.

lines.zh: 它的骨翼拍打，发出雷鸣般的声响。
lines.en: Its bone wings beat with thunderous sounds.

lines.zh: 骨质外壳在黑暗中闪耀着光辉。
lines.en: Its bone exoskeleton glows in the darkness.

lines.zh: 骨甲上的符文开始活跃起来。
lines.en: Runes on its bone armor start to glow.
First I bite your legs off.
My bone claw can already reach you.
Ring after ring of teeth opens.
Cocoon silk reaches for your ankle.
From below upward, I tear first.
One more half step and it starts.
Power is packed into every joint.
I coil my body into a ring.
I lunge at your knees.
The queen has woken inside the cocoon.

lines.zh: 发出嘶嘶声，骨甲碰撞响亮。
lines.en: Rattle bones together with a hiss.

lines.zh: 发出咔咔声，关节摩擦作响。
lines.en: Joints grind with a creak.
Spines extend, pointing at the player.

lines.zh: 挥动巨大钳子，朝你抓来。
lines.en: Lunge with massive pincers.

lines.zh: 从壳中伸出长舌，触碰你。
lines.en: Extend long tongue to touch you.

lines.zh: 咬合坚固的牙齿，试图撕裂你。
lines.en: Clamp down with strong teeth.
Swing long limbs.
Pierce your arm with spikes.

lines.zh: 用尾巴抽打，试图击倒你。
lines.en: Swing tail to knock you down.
Open maw and growl.
Bone jaws clamp on your arm.
I press on you segment by segment.
A pointed leg nails through your foot.
I curl and crush you tight.
Crawl slowly from the cocoon.
Cocoon splits, awakening you.
Break cocoon with spines.

lines.zh: 从茧中滑出，准备好战斗。
lines.en: Slither out, ready to fight.
Cocoon splits, Queen appears.
Squirm out of cocoon.
Cocoon bursts, you emerge.
Pierce cocoon with teeth.
Queen awakens from cocoon.
Cocoon splits, you awaken.
The bone cocoon pulses underground.
The sleeper turns over.
A bone tail slides out of the shell.
The cocoon below begins to breathe.
Tendrils come out of the crack first.
Bone plate scrapes against stone.
Silk threads snap one by one.
I crawl out of a thousand-year dream.
The earth shook once, and I woke.
The crystal shell splits in two.
Flames burn my shell!
Fell from the sky!
My body is full of water!
Shockwaves tear me apart!
Arrows strike me!
Magic eats my soul!
Starvation weakens me!
Lightning bleaches my cocoon white.
Darkness devours me!
